src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:45 classifies by regex over error + description + TITLE at the consumer, not at the boundary - a task titled 'fix the timeout' classifies as timeout whatever its error; the unknown default at :49 is correct

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/SelfHealingPanel.tsx:61 hitting max retries is a toast, not a recorded terminal state (exhausted is not data); lineage itself is clean - tasks.rs:963 parent_task_id/attempt is written only by retry_task and rendered at TaskCard.tsx:133

pairs.registryProposal: Coverage: the pair matched on 'retry' vocabulary, but run-desk retries are fresh attempts of a non-deterministic generator (an agent coding run), not re-calls of a dependency. The four-class table would file test_failure/build_error as permanent, yet re-running a stochastic worker on them is legitimate. The durable-retries attempt-in-the-row rule and retry-observability's exhausted-as-data rule still bite hard (the deviation above), so the pairing is earned, but the subject lacks a stated lane for 'retry = new attempt of stochastic work' (budget per lineage, classification by output not dependency health). storm-control and suspension-is-not-failure left unjudged: the queue runner's concurrency was not read.
